comments.author: @leechumbley5440
comments.text: For a period of time each year the slaughterhouses and meat-packing plants in the Chako run day and night. China and Israel purchase huge quantites of beef, in the latter case enough beef for Israel for an entire year. Fascinating to learn that jaguarete is a Guarini word. Chilling about Operation Condor. Lovely custom to sit with friends and family and pass the teneray cup around. We could all use a bit of that.

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: You're so right, we could all use a bit of that. There's something quietly powerful about a cup passed hand to hand. For anyone who grew up with tereré, what's the part of that ritual the camera could never capture?
